title: A Survey of Flow Matching in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) has recently emerged as a principled and efficient generative modeling framework for reinforcement learning (RL), enabling expressive, multimodal policy parameterizations via deterministic probability transport. Compared to diffusion-based policies that rely on stochastic denoising chains, FM uses sampling based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with learned velocity fields, which can substantially reduce inference latency and simplify the incorporation of RL objectives. As research in flow-based RL rapidly accelerates across offline continuous control, online fine-tuning, and foundation model alignment, the literature has become highly fragmented. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive taxonomy of flow-matching approaches in reinforcement learning. translated_title: 强化学习中的流匹配综述
translated_abstract: 流匹配近年来已成为强化学习中一种具有理论支撑且高效的生成建模框架，通过确定性概率传输实现表达力强、多模态的策略参数化。与依赖随机去噪链的扩散策略相比，流匹配采用基于常微分方程（ODE）的采样和学习到的速度场，可以显著降低推理延迟，并简化强化学习目标的融入过程。随着基于流的强化学习研究在离线连续控制、在线微调和基础模型对齐等领域迅速发展，相关文献已变得高度碎片化。在本综述中，我们对强化学习中的流匹配方法提供了全面的分类体系。我们沿着两个维度来组织文献：被建模的目标分布（例如，动作策略、价值评论家、转移动力学）以及机制
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了强化学习中的流匹配方法，按被建模的目标分布（动作策略、价值评论家、转移动力学等）和实现机制两个维度构建分类体系，以应对该领域文献碎片化的问题。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a comprehensive taxonomy of flow matching methods in reinforcement learning, organizing the fragmented literature along two axes: the target distribution being modeled (e.g., action policies, value critics, transition dynamics) and the underlying mechanism.
